This approach is more reliable in environments where Boolean outcomes are less visible but tends to be slower and may raise suspicion if large delays occur. 4. **Defensive Measures**: Implementing input validation, parameterized queries, stored procedures, and restricting permissions can help prevent both types of blind SQL injection attacks.
